A '''blue-skinned exhibitor''' was the first [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] to ever display an [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]] at the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]], at some point at the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the exhibit, they wore their rare pet wrapped around their shoulders like a shawl, and their likeness got captured on the spot by the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]], who was drawing illustrations for her [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]]. As shown on T'enna's [[Color/Legends|colored]] drawing, the exhibitor was a blue-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] with pointy [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They had unkempt, disheveled [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and sported facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].<ref name="WoSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although that individual's species was never identified in ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', most of his facial features match<ref name="WoSW" /> those of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] seen in the TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> He did, however, sport tapered ears,<ref name="WoSW" /> a trait that Pantorans lack.<ref name="Trespass" /> [[Leland Chee]], keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], once shared his personal theory that "all pointy-eared species are either [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] or closely related to Sephi,"<ref name="TOS">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM|quote=My theory is that all pointy-eared species are either Sephi or closely related to Sephi.}}</ref> a reference to a species from the [[2004]] comic story ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''.<ref name="J:Y">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref>
